summary.title: tmux
summary.one_liner: tmux is a terminal multiplexer that lets you run several programs in one terminal, detach them to keep running in the background, and reattach them from another terminal.
keywords: switch between programs in one terminal
terminal sessions keep running after disconnect
takeaways: tmux is a terminal multiplexer: it runs several programs inside a single terminal window.
Detaching a tmux session leaves its programs running in the background.
A detached tmux session can be reattached from a different terminal.
The page is the project's GitHub wiki home page and gives only a brief overview; it contains no installation or usage details.
